evidence.title: Agility Robotics Files Customary Registration Statements Following Completion of Business Combination
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore., Nov. 10, 2026 -- Agility™ , (Nasdaq: AGLT), a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today announced that it has filed registration statements on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”), following the completion of its previously announced business combination with Churchill Capital Corp XI (“Churchill XI”) on November 4, 2026 (the “Transaction”). These registration statements are customary following the completion of a business combination of this type and cover the potential resale of certain securities held by existing securityholders. Agility will not receive proceeds from any resales by selling securityholders. Shares held by former Agility shareholders and the Churchill sponsor will remain subject to lock-up restrictions for 180 days following the closing of the Transaction, subject to specified exceptions and early termination based on certain stock price performance measures. Neither the filing nor the effectiveness of the registration statements relating to these securities will alter or shorten the applicable lock-up restrictions.
